title: Expose character break/smash verb wired to on_break triggers and destructible items

sections.what: Expose break (alias smash) as a character action verb backed by a shared break helper that fires existing on_break triggers and unifies the NPC-only break branch in engine/triggers/behaviors.py.
sections.why: engine/triggers/constants.py (line 29) defines 'on_break' and engine/equipment.py (line 956) fires 'on_break' on worn armor collapse, while engine/triggers/behaviors.py (lines 400-416) defines an NPC 'break' branch that sets uses=0 without firing 'on_break'. Players and LLM agents have no registered break/smash verb in engine/action_registry.py or routes/action_handlers.py to intentionally destroy a phone, lock, bottle, or weapon.
sections.how: 1. Extract a shared destroy/break_item helper executing breakable/strength checks, setting uses = 0 / broken tag, firing triggers._execute_triggers(node, 'on_break', ...) (matching equipment.py line 956), and emitting impact sound.\n2. Update engine/triggers/behaviors.py (lines 400-416) to delegate to the shared helper instead of mutating uses = 0 alone.\n3. Register break (alias smash) in engine/action_registry.py, routes/action_handlers.py (_VERBS_NEEDING_TARGET + dispatcher), and PlanGrounding.PLAN_INTENT_ACTS.
sections.verify: 1. Run pytest covering break/smash command execution on fragile/on_break items, unbreakable rejection, and shared behaviors.py parity.

acceptance.text: break (alias smash) is registered in engine/action_registry.py, PlanGrounding, and routes/action_handlers.py for carried or same-area destructible items and breakable ways/containers.

Breaking sets uses = 0 / broken state, invokes existing on_break triggers (matching engine/equipment.py lines 954-960), emits a sound event via engine/sound.py, and respects indestructible/protected guards.
engine/triggers/behaviors.py line 400-416 reuses the shared break helper so NPC behavior and player break execute on_break triggers identically.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Turn Modal item brackets / command bar (`break <item>`) and Event Stream breakage narration.

Current availability: engine/triggers/behaviors.py (lines 400-416) has a partial NPC 'break' handler that sets uses=0 without firing on_break triggers, while engine/equipment.py (line 956) and triggers/constants.py define on_break without a player verb.

Manual verification steps:
1. Hold or stand near a fragile/destructible item with an on_break trigger and run `break <item>`.
   - expected: Item uses drops to 0 / breaks, on_break triggers execute cleanly, and noise alerts nearby areas.
